evidence: WHOIS registrant address for noah.edu.gr: 100 Nikolaou Plastira str., Vassilika Vouton, Heraklion Crete GR-70013, Greece (Vassilika Vouton is the University of Crete / FORTH campus area in Heraklion).

European International University (EIU) is dataset-tagged Belgium only because its accreditation body ECBE is HQ'd in Belgium. The institution itself is a legally registered private distance-education provider in France (UAI 0756213W), operating as EIU-Paris at 59 rue Lamarck, 75018 Paris (earlier 66 Av des Champs Elysees). No Belgian registered office found.

Thierry Graduate School of Leadership had its main offices in Brussels (Square de Meeus) from 2000; in 2009 it added a campus in the Ardennes. WHOIS for thierryschool.org masks the registrant but lists Registrant State/Province: France (a coordination point). Belgian seat = Brussels.

American University in Bosnia and Herzegovina's main campus is in Tuzla (per Wikipedia and IAU WHED); postgraduate dept later opened in Sarajevo, undergrad depts in Banja Luka and Mostar. The .ba WHOIS Sarajevo address is the UTIC registry contact, not the institution seat.

Knightsbridge University is a known diploma mill (listed by AACRAO 2009) but it did operate from a real Danish address in Spentrup, Denmark, founded 1991 by Henrik Fyrst Kristensen. Was variously incorporated in Liberia/Antigua with a Scotland mailing address.

Scandinavian Art and Business Institute (SABI), founded 2006 in Finland (later 'Sabi University', absorbed into Canada-based Learntura Group in 2018). All sources confirm Finland but no source (site, brochure, directory) gives a verifiable Finnish city; left blank to avoid fabrication.

European Institute of Education (eieonline.com, now 'eie European Business School') is a government-licensed Maltese institution based in St. Julian's, Malta (STJ 3019). WHOIS shows a Shield Whois privacy proxy (Sweden), not the real seat.

University of Sint Eustatius School of Medicine's campus was on the Caribbean island of Sint Eustatius (Goldenrock), later relocating to Sint Maarten then Barbados (became AUIS). Caribbean / non-European seat per instructions, so city left blank. Documented location: Goldenrock, Sint Eustatius.

International University School of Medicine (IUSOM) main campus & HQ is at Kaya Mofi 1, Kralendijk, Bonaire (Caribbean Netherlands), with additional campuses in Barranquilla (Colombia), Mexico City, Sialkot (Pakistan). Caribbean / non-mainland-European seat per instructions, so city left blank. Documented location: Kralendijk, Bonaire.

Dutch Delta University (ddu.nl) listed at Hondenbergseweg 12-1, Wapenveld, Netherlands (some directories also cite Deventer). The .nl WHOIS Arnhem P.O. Box is the SIDN registry contact, not the institution.

europeanopenuniversity.com is 'Under Construction' (Dutch text). WHOIS registrant org 'Nedlook internet' (Netherlands) with city redacted for privacy. No verifiable city found; left blank to avoid fabrication.
foundationuniversity.com WHOIS registrant is HugeDomains.com (domain for sale, 2635 Walnut Street, Denver). No institution operating; defunct/parked, no real seat.

Hogeschool Inholland is a large real Dutch university of applied sciences with multiple campuses; its statutory/administrative headquarters (College van Bestuur) is registered in Haarlem (Bijdorplaan 15). Other large sites in The Hague, Amsterdam, Alkmaar, Rotterdam. The .nl WHOIS Arnhem address is the SIDN registry.

Instituto Piaget (Cooperativa para o Desenvolvimento Humano, Integral e Ecologico CRL, NIF 501048740) has its registered seat (sede social) in Lisboa, Avenida Joao Paulo II, Lote 544, 1950-157 Lisboa. Campuses spread across Almada, Vila Nova de Gaia, Viseu, Silves, etc.

Instituto Superior de Saude do Alto Ave (ISAVE), founded 2015, is located in Povoa de Lanhoso, Braga district, northern Portugal (renamed 'ISAVE - Instituto Superior de Saude' in 2017). The .pt WHOIS Lisboa address is the registrar contact.
WHOIS registrant address for ime.ru: 8 Marta street 1, bld 12, Moscow 127083, Russian Federation. Institute of Management and Economy registered in Moscow.
miom.org redirects to a GoDaddy 'domain for sale' parking page. The Modern Institute of Management is defunct; no operating site and no verifiable physical seat.

universidadatlantico.org now 301-redirects to uneatlantico.es. 'Iniciativa Universidad del Atlantico' was the precursor name for the Universidad Europea del Atlantico (UNEATLANTICO), a recognised private university in the Cantabria Science & Technology Park (PCTCAN) in Santander, Spain.

phw.info ('Fachhochschule Pur') is an older reference for the Private Hochschule Wirtschaft PHW Bern, a private business school in Bern, Switzerland (Max-Daetwyler-Platz 1, 3014 Bern). Live phw.info is dead; current site phw.ch.

swissu.org ('University of Switzerland') serves only a generic 'We're getting things ready' placeholder with a domain-purchase link; no impressum, contact, or address. Appears to be a non-operating / diploma-mill style domain with no verifiable Swiss seat.

Victoria University (Switzerland), via its VU School of Management (vubs.ch), is located in Neuchatel (Avenue de la Gare 2); the canton of Neuchatel approved 'Victoria University' in 2002. The .ch WHOIS Zurich/Werdstrasse address is the SWITCH registry contact.

International Centre for Islamic Science (ICIS, kolieh.com) was founded in London in 1989 as a charitable organisation, with its first college established in London in 1990. WHOIS is privacy-redacted.

williamgilbert.co.uk does not resolve (connection refused) and no directory/news source confirms a city for 'William Gilbert College'. The WHOIS address (Minerva House, Edmund Halley Road, Oxford Science Park) is the registrar/hosting agent (NetNames), not the institution. No verifiable seat; left blank to avoid fabrication.
IAE France is the national network (Conference des directeurs d'IAE) of French university management schools; its headquarters is at 8 Bis rue de la Croix Jarry, 75644 Paris Cedex 13, France.
WHOIS for pass26.edu.mk lists registrant/admin addresses in Skopje, North Macedonia (Blvd. Partizanski Odredi 17, Skopje 1000; and 'Rugjer Boshkovikj' 16, Skopje 1000).
